synthesis:draft.headline: Peak RRP in SA1 was 4981.0 $/MWh at 2026-07-31 02:05 ACST
summary: Peak RRP = 4981.0 $/MWh at interval ending 2026-07-31 02:05 ACST (evidence: ev0001).
The price timeline available as of 2026-07-30T06:00:00Z shows eight five-minute intervals at or above the analysis threshold of 300.0 $/MWh (evidence: ev0029; threshold evidence: ev0030).
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at the five-minute price peak (interval ending 2026-07-30T04:35:00Z / 2026-07-30 14:05 ACST) is 1235.61 MW (dispatch TOTALDEMAND, evidence: ev0005).

AEMO operational demand forecast runs that were provably public by 2026-07-30T06:00:00Z show for the half-hour ending 2026-07-30T17:00:00Z (2026-07-31 02:30 ACST) POE50 = 1508.0 MW, POE10 = 1609.0 MW, POE90 = 1407.0 MW from the run published 2026-07-30T03:02:06Z (evidence: ev0568, ev0569, ev0570).
An earlier public run (published 2026-07-28T04:32:24Z) gave for the same half-hour POE50 = 1510.0 MW, POE10 = 1627.0 MW, POE90 = 1393.0 MW (evidence: ev0064, ev0065, ev0066).
For where AEMO uses weather for load forecasting: “For the purposes of load forecasting, a major regional load centre will be used as the weather reference for that area or region.” [c1]

possible_explanations.statement: Differences between forecast runs (for example the POE50 = 1508.0 MW run ev0568 and the POE50 = 1510.0 MW run ev0064) may reflect updated inputs such as weather updates or generator availability; comparing the two runs' issue times and any run notes would test this.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the full run metadata and any accompanying notes for the runs ev0568 and ev0064, and check published weather inputs for the same as-of times.

possible_explanations.statement: The evidence search did not return an AEMO-published Adelaide weather forecast for 2026-07-31 provably public by 2026-07-30T06:00:00Z; this might mean BOM forecasts used by AEMO were not indexed by the search or were not published as AEMO notices — checking BOM archives and non-AEMO weather products for Adelaide as of 2026-07-30T06:00:00Z would test this.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve BOM forecast archives for Adelaide for 2026-07-31 and search other public weather sources that AEMO might use.
